technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with rising RSI suggest potential bounce, but lack of bullish momentum confirmation, negative CMF/AO, and price below key moving averages create high execution risk for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MET shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 47 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional buying by junior members, broad market fear (38/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (240+), and recent FOMC event creating hostile environment for financials; earnings in 47 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 extreme oversold (below 30) with supertrend bullish and EMA 50/200 bullish alignment creates textbook bounce setup near support at 64.39, offering asymmetric risk/reward in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below both EMA 9 and EMA 21, negative CMF/AO/OBV, weak ADX trend strength, zero momentum confirmation, earnings event risk in 47 days, and macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 240+, credit spreads elevated) make this a false-bottom trap with hostile execution environment.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI extreme oversold with supertrend bullish offers technical bounce setup, but negative momentum (CMF, AO, OBV), price below key EMAs, and zero institutional conviction create weak entry quality with high execution risk.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 240+, credit spreads elevated) combined with earnings event in 47 days and lack of momentum confirmation make this a false-bottom trap in hostile market conditions.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical bounce case conflicts sharply with fundamental void, sentiment weakness, and severe macro deterioration; bear case dominates.
decision.portfolio_note: Existing MET position plus 12 open Financials positions create sector concentration risk; skip entry to avoid compounding exposure in crisis-level macro environment.
